name: French Fourth Republic
alt: Provisional Government of the French Republic (1944-1946)

predecessors.name: Free France
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's last Free French shape (1944, 89,085 km2), the liberated part of metropolitan France; the Fourth Republic row begins in 1945 with all of metropolitan France

successors.name: French Fifth Republic
successors.text: metropolitan France and its overseas departments under the constitution of 4 October 1958

ledger.x: 1945: the republic that becomes the Fourth Republic governs a liberated France.
July 1945: the French zone in south-west Germany takes shape.
July 1945: the French zone of Austria.
16 February 1946: France 'established the separate Saar Protectorate' by separating the Saar from the Allied zones of occupation.
19 March 1946: Réunion becomes an overseas department.
27 October 1946: the Provisional Government of the French Republic gives way to the Fourth Republic.
1947: Italy cedes the Tende and La Brigue valleys to France.
23 May 1949: the French zone becomes part of West Germany.
25 October 1955: the last occupying troops leave Austria.
1 January 1957: the Saar becomes a West German state.
October 1958: the Fourth Republic gives way to the Fifth.

wars.name: First Indochina War
wars.outcome: The page dates the war from 19 December 1946; at the Geneva Conference of 1954 the Viet Minh gained 'control of Vietnam north of the 17th parallel'.

wars.name: Algerian War
wars.outcome: The war begins on 1 November 1954 and continues past the end of the Fourth Republic; the page gives only the start, the Algiers crisis of 1958 and the call on de Gaulle on 29 May 1958.

certainty.note: Metropolitan France is a treaty-bounded state (Tende and La Brigue by the 1947 treaty); the occupation-zone lines were agreed on 9 July 1945 (Austria) and 1945 (Germany); the Saar frontier is the 1946 separation line.
